sections.title: A day of places
sections.content: Plan a day with times of day and places. Use *-ba/-be* with *megyek* and *-ban/-ben* with *vagyok* or an activity: *Reggel a parkba megyek. Délelőtt a múzeumban vagyok. Délben az étteremben ebédelek. Délután a moziba megyek.* New words: *program* (plan for the day) and *délelőtt* (late morning). Ask *Mi a program ma?*

items.english: What is the plan for today?
In the morning I am going to the park.
In the late morning I am in the museum.
At noon I have lunch in the restaurant.
In the evening I am at home.

sections.content: The time of day usually comes first: *Délután a moziba megyek.*
